description: This PHP class defines an interface to connect and interact with a MantisBT bug tracking system via a REST API. It includes methods for establishing a connection, fetching issue details, checking issue status, adding and removing issue links, and configuration helpers.

classes.name: mantisrestInterface
classes.description: A class providing an interface to the MantisBT bug tracking system via REST API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes and connects to the Mantis bug tracker with given configuration.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration details by setting default URLs and options.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the current API client instance.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID string has valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the MantisBT system and authenticates.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the connection to the bug tracker is active.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to view a specific bug by ID.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific issue from MantisBT.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Provides a human-readable status string for an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string for the issue summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks whether a bug ID exists in the system.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Creates a link between the specified issue and another entity.

methods.name: removeLink
methods.description: Removes a link between the specified issue and another entity.

methods.name: addExecLink
methods.description: Adds execution details as a link to a bug.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Returns an XML template for configuring the Mantis integration.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issue creation via API is supported.
